prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for a retro pixel-art browser action game.
Primary request: A completely NEW liquid-metal robotic creature formed when melted chrome endoskeletons engulf a horse carriage. A sleek predatory chrome quadruped that runs along the ground and fires guided rockets from its back. This is NOT a spider, NOT a cart on insect legs, NOT a vehicle.
Input images: Image1 is Omacontra enemy artwork: reference ONLY the rich arcade pixel shading, strong material highlights and craftsmanship. Image2 is the game's existing small Rambo-style hero: reference his skin tone, forearms, fingerless gloves for the two hand accessories in the final cell.
Style: High-fidelity 16-bit/32-bit shaded PIXEL ART. Black/steel shadows, sharply reflective silver and white liquid-chrome highlights, faint green reflections, two small red eye lights. Rounded flowing metal musculature, visible glossy contours like mercury, not a rusty armored machine. No realistic photograph, smooth 3D, vector outline art or line drawings.
Composition: 1536x1024 PNG with GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background. Exact THREE columns by TWO rows of 512x512 cells. No background, halos, drop shadows, grid, words, frame or extra items. Keep at least 25px clear alpha padding inside every cell.
Creature cells 1,2,3,4 (top-left, top-middle, top-right, bottom-left): FOUR consistent side-view RUN CYCLE frames of the SAME chrome beast FACING RIGHT. Slender elongated torso, hunched powerful shoulders, short angular wolf/horse-like robotic head, pointed ears, narrow red eye, articulated jaw, four athletic digitigrade legs ending in three-toed metal claws, long curved metal tail trailing LEFT. Only FOUR legs, not six or eight. No wheels. A compact twin-tube rocket launcher grows out of the upper back, angled up/right at 60 degrees; tube openings clearly visible. Chrome skin reflects white on top and charcoal undersides. Several flowing melted ribs imply the old cart's arched hay-pile shape, but no hay wagon attached. Same head shape, same launcher, same body width and scale each frame. Whole creature about 440px wide, 280px tall, ground baseline y430 in its cell. Frame1 near front paw extended forward/back paw back. Frame2 paws gathered under body. Frame3 opposite diagonal stride. Frame4 reaching stride with slight body compression. Entire long tail, all legs, launcher and head remain inside each cell.
Cell5 (bottom-middle): A single isolated broad shallow pool of glossy SILVER LIQUID METAL. Irregular mercury lobes, flat low puddle, dark reflective bands, clean white specular ripples, approximately 440px wide by 90px high, centered in cell. No robot or ground plane.
Cell6 (bottom-right): TWO SEPARATE isolated right FOREARMS and HANDS only from the referenced hero, arranged one above the other with generous alpha separation. Natural muscular tanned skin, dark fingerless glove, no shirt, NO gun. Upper accessory at y100-220: elbow on LEFT, bent forearm reaches diagonally down RIGHT to a hand clasping a small olive pineapple grenade, silver pin ring visible. Lower accessory at y300-420: same forearm and elbow anchor but hand open with fingers extended downward, just released grenade; NO grenade in this lower hand. Anatomically correct compact hands, dark outlines and clustered pixel highlights. These will attach to the existing 32-pixel hero shoulder; no head or torso.
All assets fully contained, clean transparent silhouettes, consistent rich arcade sprites and production-ready separations.
runtime: Four chrome quadruped run frames, a mercury puddle and two grenade-hand poses. Alpha preserved. Runtime crops and anchors in src/liquid-assets.js.
